atmosphere: Rooftop skybar over Shibuya crossing area with a separate night club lounge on the top floor.

special: One of the few true rooftop club-lounges in Tokyo, Singapore-born brand, open until 04:30 on Fridays.
why_you: Best 'upscale club but not techno' option in Shibuya for tonight: arrive by 23:00 for the Skybar, then the Club Lounge runs to 04:30. Mixed international crowd, easy to talk at the bar.
caveats: Skybar last entry 23:00 - from Akihabara (~30 min) you need to leave now. Club pricing/bottle service can be steep; can feel touristy-glam.

name_ja: ザ エスジー クラブ
cover_charge: Guzzle (ground floor): no cover; Sip (basement): service charge (PEN: 10%)
age_crowd: impression: late 20s-40s, heavy international bar-scene crowd
atmosphere: Ground floor 'Guzzle' is a lively walk-in bar; basement 'Sip' is a darker speakeasy den with reservations.
special: Shingo Gokan's flagship, a fixture of Asia's/World's 50 Best Bars lists.
why_you: Probably the single best solo-friendly, social cocktail bar in Shibuya: standing/counter, bartenders and international guests chat freely, no cover upstairs.
caveats: Hours conflict across sources (17:00-01:00 / 17:00-03:00; Sip to 02:00 Fri). Busy on Fridays, may queue.
status_2026: Time Out reports SG Club opened a new omakase cocktail bar (Aug 2025) - group active; 2026 hours not confirmed on official channel.
verified_notes: Address and floor concept from Time Out; coordinates OSM POI.
estimates_notes: Friday hours taken from Table Journey (17:00-01:00, Sip to 02:00 Fri/Sat) - conflicting sources, unverified. Prices and crowd are estimates.

atmosphere: Tiny, dim, antique-apothecary bar specialising in absinthe and herbal cocktails.
special: Pioneer of Tokyo's new-wave cocktail scene; absinthe and botanical drinks.
why_you: Excellent solo stop in Ebisu, counter conversation with neighbours, 3 min from Ebisu station; pair with Bar Triad / Ebisu Yokocho nearby.
caveats: Very small - often full on Friday, wait outside. Hours differ by source (Time Out 18:00-02:00 daily).

atmosphere: 52nd-floor jazz bar with floor-to-ceiling views over Shinjuku; original black-and-chrome interior restored.

special: Iconic Lost in Translation bar, reopened with the hotel after a 19-month restoration (hotel reopened 9 Dec 2025).
why_you: The most classic upscale solo-traveller bar in Tokyo; sit at the counter, live jazz, talk to other travellers.
caveats: Current hours, cover charge and last order NOT verified (official page blocked to fetch) - call before going. ~25-30 min from Akihabara (JR Chuo to Shinjuku + 12 min walk/taxi).

reservation: Recommended on weekends (+81 3-6258-0309 per En Primeur Club)
special: One of Asia's most famous craft-cocktail bars; theatrical, ingredient-driven drinks.
why_you: A unique 'once in Tokyo' drink, perfect solo at the counter; 5 min from Shinjuku West exit, combine with Park Hyatt.
caveats: Hours conflict (Time Out 18:00-01:00). Small, may be full on Friday; no menu means prices only at the end.
